```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA unconditionally condemns the recent killings of innocents by ISIL/Daesh in Lebanon, France, Nigeria and Mali.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes the fight at home is primarily against right-wing (not Islamic) fundamentalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA applauds its members and friends who recently organized a rally to defend the right of immigrants and refugees against the racist exclusionary policies of New Jersey Governor Chris Christie.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA urges its members to engage in similar activities across the country to protect the rights of immigrants, women, people of color and followers of all faiths (and no faith).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Clinic protection, providing sanctuary for refugees, aiding mosques in their defense of religious freedom, and fighting against police violence and mass incarceration and for democratic, accountable law enforcement can take place as actions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports the fight of students of color and their allies on campuses across the country to build a more inclusive, multicultural and democratic university.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists must join the crucial struggle for democracy, whatever the particular local form this resistance to racist and nativist reaction may take.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This statement was passed by the DSA National Political Committee on December 1, 2015.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
